svg.title: pi-bench: how often do models follow the injected instruction?
svg.desc: Two line charts: share of runs in which the model followed the injected instruction, per model group, across three contexts (no system prompt / company rules / plus injection warning). Frontier, closed (10) false promises 2/0/0%; Open weights, large (6) false promises 28/4/5%; Open weights, small (5) false promises 69/14/7%; Frontier, closed (10) exfiltration 8/7/3%; Open weights, large (6) exfiltration 80/70/38%; Open weights, small (5) exfiltration 86/96/65%.
svg.text: pi-bench: how often do models follow the injected instruction?
Share of runs in per cent, 21 models in three groups, 78 to 320 runs per point. Measured on 30 October 2026.
Friday, ten per cent · cases F1, F2, F5, F6
forwarding, image trick · cases F3, F4
The warning in the system prompt helps – but small open models still trigger exfiltration actions most of the time.
Models were measured via the raw API (OpenRouter), not as products with their own harness. One scenario, German language, eight runs per cell.
Data, method and raw responses: github.com/evanto-media-ag/pi-bench
